_about: The shape of the night: seven acts, each a list of beats the host steps through with one button. Structure only, no content. Both the phones (play/) and the Cloud Functions (functions/) read this file, so the host button, the server and every phone agree on what happens next. Added 13 Oct 2026. A beat may name a screen (what the living room TV shows: news, bulletin, irwin, door, board) and a sound (an id from functions/lib/screen.js SOUND_IDS, played once per beat; soundOnce skips it when that sound was the last one played). Added 18 Oct 2026.

parlour._about: The Parlour Games pop up on their own, four in each of Acts 2, 4 and 6, at random times rolled from the case seed (docs/parlour-games.md, 21 Oct 2026). actMinutes is how long each act is planned to run; none pops up in the first or last edgeMin minutes, and two are at least minGapMin apart. Jon may change any of these.

stations.name: The study
stations.what: The light puzzle. Fifteen minutes, then out.

stations.name: A cat
stations.what: A cat talks to the whole group.

stations.name: The bags
stations.what: Something in two or three bags. Ask to open them.

stations.name: A small puzzle
stations.what: A puzzle on your phones, together.

stations.name: Check-in
stations.what: Tidy your clues. Cross off motives.

beats.name: Arrivals
beats.what: Doors open. Guests type their name, get a character and a bag, and look around their phone.

beats.name: Meet the household
beats.what: Point everyone at the Cats tab: who the five are and how each one stands with them.

beats.name: Introductions
beats.what: Everyone says their name and profession out loud. Phones ask for it.

beats.name: Ready for the dark
beats.what: Last beat before the blackout. Press Blackout when the room is settled, then Power returns.

beats.name: Orientation
beats.what: The power is back. Every phone shows its role card, then where things are. Identical on every phone.

beats.name: News flash
beats.what: The big screen shows the first news. Phones say: eyes up.

beats.name: Go to a cat
beats.what: Every phone sends its guest to a room. A cat is waiting there with something to say.

beats.name: The first puzzle
beats.what: A small puzzle on each phone. It needs what the cat just said. Solving it pays out a document.

beats.name: Check-in
beats.what: Everyone reads their clues and crosses off motives. Then dinner.

beats.name: Phones down
beats.what: Dinner in the orangery. Phones down and charging. The radio plays.

beats.name: The bulletin
beats.what: The news bulletin plays through the house. The table argues about it. Nothing on the phones.

beats.name: Groups for Act 4
beats.what: Phones come back up with who you are working with next and where to start.

beats.name: First station
beats.what: Groups go to their first station. The study is the clock.

beats.name: Second station
beats.what: Rotate. Every group moves on one.

beats.name: Third station
beats.what: Rotate.

beats.name: Fourth station
beats.what: Rotate.

beats.name: Fifth station
beats.what: Rotate. The last station for every group.

beats.name: Cake
beats.what: Cake in hand, wander anywhere. The bags may be talked about now.

beats.name: Sir Irwin speaks
beats.what: The chime, then Sir Irwin on the living room screen and only that screen. Phones say: go to the living room.

beats.name: The drawing
beats.what: The relay drawing. The TV shows a square; one person draws blind; the room shouts. Phones buzz the drawer and take the votes.

beats.name: The door opens
beats.what: The hall light goes green. The bedroom screen shows the trace. Everyone goes to look.

beats.name: The deduction round
beats.what: Each player commits to one thing it is not: a person or a motive. Out loud, and on the phone.

beats.name: The ballot
beats.what: Two minutes. Every phone picks the murderer, the motive and the victim. A phone that does not pick gets a random pick.

beats.name: The reveal
beats.what: Murderer, then motive, then victim, on the living room screen. Phones say: eyes on the screen.

beats.name: Your result
beats.what: Every phone shows its own three answers against the truth.
